_om: Tieren in English (Tenner, rusj.no/en/tenner/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. The cards are in data.en/ (British English), written for players in the UK; the «Norge» category is «Britain». Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Had {n} in the pot at the most.
Potten røk for alle. Neste gang: stopp l: Everyone's pot went bust. Next time: stop a little sooner!
Ti svar ligger rundt ringen. Ta ett om g: Ten answers sit around the ring. Take one at a time – but one wrong answer and your pot goes bust.
Den som har tur, trykker på ett av de ti: Whoever's turn it is taps one of the ten answers on the ring.
Ja eller nei, et tall, en gruppe eller e: Yes or no, a number, a group or a place in the order. A right answer puts 1 point in your pot.
Feil svar, og potten ryker – da er du ut: One wrong answer and your pot goes bust – you're out of the round. Stop whenever you like to bank your points.
Runden er over når alle har stoppet elle: The round ends when everyone has stopped or gone bust – or when all ten answers are taken.
Har du ingenting i potten, har du heller: Nothing in your pot means nothing to lose. Go for it!
A different player starts each round.
Trykket «Stopp» ved et uhell? «Angre» re: Tapped ‘Stop’ by accident? ‘Undo’ saves you until the next player has picked.
Most points after the last round wins.
Ten answers. One wrong and the pot goes bust.
Mobilen går rundt – eller ligger midt på: Pass the phone round – or lay it in the middle of the table.
Velg minst én kategori under «Flere valg: Choose at least one category under ‘More options’.
Fant ingen kort – velg flere kategorier: No cards found – choose more categories

Bare {n} kort passet – kjør på!.one: Only {n} card fitted – off you go!

det gule tallet er potten, som ikke er t: the yellow number is the pot, which isn't safe yet
Dere går rett til kåringen med poengene: You'll go straight to the results with the points from {runder}.
